# truenas_network_config (Data Source)

Reads the current `network.configuration` settings. Secrets are not exposed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `activity` (Attributes) Network activity filtering configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--activity))
- `domain` (String) System domain name.
- `domains` (List of String) Additional domain names for DNS search.
- `hostname` (String) System hostname.
- `hostname_b` (String) Hostname for the second controller in HA configurations or `null`.
- `hostname_local` (String) Local hostname for this system.
- `hostname_virtual` (String) Virtual hostname for HA configurations or `null`.
- `hosts` (List of String) Static host entries to add to the hosts file.
- `httpproxy` (String) Must be provided if a proxy is to be used for network operations.
- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.
- `ipv4gateway` (String) Used instead of the default gateway provided by DHCP.
- `ipv6gateway` (String) IPv6 default gateway address.
- `nameserver1` (String) Primary DNS server.
- `nameserver2` (String) Secondary DNS server.
- `nameserver3` (String) Tertiary DNS server.
- `service_announcement` (Attributes) Determines the broadcast protocols that will be used to advertise the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_announcement))

<a id="nestedatt--activity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `activity`

Read-Only:

- `activities` (List of String) Array of network activity types to allow or deny.
- `type` (String) Whether to allow or deny the specified network activities.


<a id="nestedatt--service_announcement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_announcement`

Read-Only:

- `mdns` (Boolean) Enable multicast DNS service announcements for enabled services.
- `netbios` (Boolean) Enable the NetBIOS name server (NBNS) which starts concurrently with the SMB service. SMB clients will only     perform NBNS lookups if SMB1 is enabled. NBNS may be required for legacy SMB clients.
- `wsd` (Boolean) Enable Web Service Discovery support.
